# D3

D3 7.9.0, ISC licensed. Downloaded from the pinned npm distribution:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/LICENSE

Official project: https://github.com/d3/d3

The local copy lets both the complete website and standalone preview render
interactive plots without a runtime CDN dependency.

# Selects and floating study cards

- Tom Select 2.4.3 (`tom-select-2.4.3.min.js`), Apache-2.0; license alongside.
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tom-select@2.4.3/dist/js/tom-select.complete.min.js
- Floating UI core 1.7.3 and DOM 1.7.4, MIT; licenses alongside.
  Sources: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@floating-ui/core@1.7.3/dist/floating-ui.core.umd.min.js
  and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@floating-ui/dom@1.7.4/dist/floating-ui.dom.umd.min.js

The homepage styles these components using its own design tokens. Tom Select
handles searchable listboxes and keyboard interaction; Floating UI positions the
study card beside its point, flips when space is constrained, and tracks scrolling.
